Location containing FLUXNET daily stationdata.

This directory shpuld be used in the .yml in order to run the FLUXNET benchmarks.
The functions found to run the FLUXNET benchmark chunks handle processing and reading of the data.
Make sure that the station coordinates are the same as the simulated.

Can be downloaded from 
https://data.icos-cp.eu/portal/#%7B%22filterCategories%22:%7B%22project%22:%5B%22icos%22%5D,%22level%22:%5B1,2%5D,%22stationclass%22:%5B%22ICOS%22%5D%7D%7D
